description:
About the job




About Us

Dymax, part of the Bachmann Chemical & Engineering family of brands is based out of Torrington, Connecticut. Dymax is globally recognized as a pioneer in the development of light-curable adhesives and curing equipment. Today, our expansive portfolio of innovative adhesives, coatings, and maskants are supported by dispense solutions and cutting-edge UV and LED light-curing equipment. Unlike our competitors who supplying standard products, Dymax focuses on the customer experience by tailoring solutions that help customers lower costs, reduce their carbon footprint, improve efficiency, and drive profitability. Our focus on being a customer intimate organization has led us to where we are today: a rapidly expanding force within our industry, an innovative product portfolio, extraordinary employees, and a bright future based on creating quality offerings with a dedication to business growth.

About You

We're seeking a result-focused, innovative, self-driven, and well-qualified individual to join our talented team as our Engagement & Demand Generation MarCom Specialist. You will execute integrated MarCom activities that generate brand awareness, engagement, and leads by developing and deploying content, campaigns, and promotional assets across digital, social, and event channels, applying established messaging and brand guidelines to deliver consistent, accurate, and effective communications for an assigned brand or portfolio.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Execute integrated marketing communications activities for an assigned brand or portfolio by developing content and campaign materials aligned with established messaging and marketing direction across digital, social, email, web, and event channels
Create multichannel marketing assets that enable effective customer engagement by drafting, designing, editing, and publishing content, including graphics, videos, written materials, presentations, and promotional collateral for use across campaigns and sales enablement efforts
Deliver digital marketing campaigns that build awareness and generate inbound interest by executing activities across web properties, search marketing, social media, and marketing automation platforms in accordance with defined campaign objectives and timelines
Apply market and performance insight to improve marketing execution by monitoring campaign results, engagement metrics, and channel performance, and using insights to refine tactics and improve effectiveness within established frameworks
Coordinate marketing communications schedules and content calendars by planning, maintaining, and adjusting editorial schedules that align day-to-day communications activity with campaign timing, business priorities, and channel-specific delivery requirements
Manage external vendors, agencies, and partners to support marketing execution by coordinating inputs, clarifying requirements, reviewing deliverables for accuracy and quality, and ensuring content is delivered on time and aligned with established brand and campaign expectations
Execute events and promotional activities by coordinating event logistics, stakeholders, materials, messaging, and follow-up activities that reinforce brand presence, enable engagement, and capture participation and lead outcomes for reporting and review


Requirements



You should have: 

BS/BA degree in Communications, Marketing, or equivalency
Experience executing integrated marketing communications or digital marketing activities across multiple channels
Working knowledge of MarCom tools and platforms, including social media, content management systems, marketing automation, and analytics tools
Strong writing, editing, and content development capability with attention to detail and brand consistency
Ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently and apply sound judgment within established marketing direction
This role requires strong English communication skills, including the ability to speak, read, and write clearly and effectively

 



Benefits



Dymax takes the compensation of its employees very seriously and considers several factors when determining the total compensation package including but not limited to location, market range, skills, knowledge, experience, and abilities. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Dymax salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range. The range listed is just one component of Dymax's total compensation packages for employees.


Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in Mexico.


Dymax provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, domestic violence status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

description:
About the job

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Solicitamos: Trainee de Comunicación y Marketing.

Objetivo de la vacante: Dar soporte operativo, administrativo y logístico a los proyectos del área para asegurar que la operación diaria de Mercadotecnia y Comunicación se mantenga ágil y fluida, alineada a la estrategia de la marca.

Escolaridad: Lic. Mercadotecnia, Comunicación o Administración (Egresados).

Experiencia: 6 meses en trabajos similares o haber realizado proyectos relacionados.

Idioma: Inglés (Básico/Intermedio).

Actividades Principales


Apoyar en la operación diaria del departamento de Mercadotecnia y Comunicación para la unidad de negocio de Volvo Trucks en México.
Apoyar en la administración de proyectos, seguimiento a cronogramas y estructuración de datos para la planeación, ejecución y evaluación de las diferentes iniciativas.

Colaborar en la coordinación operativa de convocatorias, eventos internos y externos, expos y congresos de la marca.
Generación de reportes cualitativos y cuantitativos que permitan evaluar los resultados de las diferentes iniciativas implementadas por Mercadotecnia y Comunicación.
Coordinar requerimientos con proveedores y áreas internas.


Ubicación: Manzana 015, 54980 Santiago Teyahualco, State of Mexico.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Who We Are And What We Believe In

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

At Volvo Trucks you will be part of leading the way towards a sustainable transport industry. For nearly a century we have been innovating for people – to make life easier, better and safer. Driving progress is our promise to customers, to the industry and to society. At Volvo Trucks we share a curiosity to learn, we work with passion and we embrace change to stay ahead. Join us, together we move the world we want to live in.

description:
About the job

Carestream Health Inc.

Innovation that sparks imagination. Continue on to your next challenge with us.

Carestream is a worldwide provider of medical imaging systems and solutions; x-ray imaging systems for non-destructive testing; manufacturing of film and precision contract coating services for a wide range of industrial, medical, electronic and other applications—all backed by a global service and support network. Carestream’s diagnostic imaging technology systems are at work in 90 percent of hospitals worldwide.

At Carestream, we offer a global perspective and a world of opportunities for people who have the desire to make a positive impact. Join our global team of 3,000+ professionals!

Position Summary:

At Carestream, we are seeking anexpert for the annual RSNA (Radiological Society of NorthAmerica) meeting to coordinate and oversee the end-to-end management of the entire process—ensuring absolute success—as well as to participate in other trade shows around the world to promote our brand and products. This role will lead exhibition planning, execution, vendor coordination, and client relationship management to ensure optimal brand presentation and participation outcomes at international events. Additionally, this position will serve as a key liaison for the company's digital accounts, collaborating closely with the marketing team to effectively convert offline exhibition traffic into online digital assets.

Position Responsibilities:

1. Our RSNA Expert · Manage the full lifecycle of planning and execution for the RSNA annual meeting and other overseas exhibitions, including booth reservation, exhibit material shipping, construction plan coordination, and on-site services.· Maintain efficient communication with venues, external suppliers (construction, logistics, service providers) to ensure the smooth execution of all exhibition phases.· Develop and manage project timelines and quality standards, ensuring critical milestones are met on schedule.· Oversee on-site operations during exhibitions, including construction supervision, activity execution, and emergency handling.· Possess thorough knowledge of RSNA rules and regulations to ensure exhibition behavior complies with organizer requirements and mitigates compliance risks.

2. Supplier and Budget Management· Participate in the tendering, evaluation, and selection process for service suppliers (construction, logistics, PR, etc.), managing the Request for Proposals (RFP) process.· Prepare and monitor exhibition project budgets, including booth fees, construction costs, shipping, travel expenses, etc., ensuring expenditures stay within budget and identifying cost-saving opportunities.· Responsible for reviewing, archiving, and ensuring compliance for all exhibition-related contracts.

3. Client Relations and Sales Support· Maintain efficient communication with exhibitors, providing professional services and on-site support.· Nurture existing client relationships, identify potential client needs, and assist the sales team with registration and administrative processes.· Collaborate with the digital marketing team to ensure sales leads generated during exhibitions are effectively entered into the CRM system (e.g., Salesforce) for data integration.

4. Cross-Cultural Communication & International Coordination· Navigate cross-regional and cross-cultural work environments, building strong collaborative relationships with overseas organizers, service providers, and partners.· Adapt to overseas travel requirements, leading teams toparticipate in RSNA and other international exhibitions, providing on-site support and problem-solving.· Coordinate with internal departments (Marketing, Sales, Product, etc.) to ensure exhibition objectives align with the company's overall strategy.

5. Documentation and Reporting· Organize, archive, and manage exhibition-related documents, including participation contracts, service agreements, and exhibition materials.· Regularly prepare comprehensive post-exhibition summary reports, including effectiveness evaluation, ROI analysis, and recommendations for improvement.

· Monitor industry trends and exhibition developments, providing data-driven insights and optimization suggestions for the company's exhibition strategy.

Required Skills & Education:

1. Education Background· Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in International Business, Exhibition Management, Marketing, or a related field.

2. Work Experience· Minimum 3 years of project management experience specifically with overseas exhibitions, having success fully led the preparation and execution of multiple international events.·

Experience with RSNA or other major medical/professional international exhibitions is highly preferred.· Experience in domestic and international exhibition organization is preferred.

3. Professional Skills· Proficient in the full cycle of exhibition project management, including planning, execution, and evaluation.· Familiar with international trade practices and characteristics of overseas markets, possessing strong negotiation skills.· Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Asana).· Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g.,Salesforce) is a plus.· Experience in financial modeling and budget management is an advantage.

4. Language Ability· Fluent in English with excellent listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills, capable of using English as a working language for business communication with international partners.· Overseas work or study background is highly preferred.

5. Core Competencies· Excellent communication, coordination, and execution skills, capable of building and maintaining strong collaborative relationships across departments and international teams.· Strong project and time management skills, able to handle multiple tasks and emergencies simultaneously.· High sense of responsibility and strong ability to work under pressure, adaptable too verseas travel and the high-intensity pace of exhibition work.· Strong learning agility and marketin sight, capable of quickly grasping industry dynamics.· Customer-oriented mindset with attention to detail and a pursuit of excellence in the industry’s exhibition experience.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Being customer obsessed and data driven is what drives this role. We’re looking for individuals who can empathize with users, and work towards making their everyday lives easier. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. The role will require rotational working hours to ensure smooth operational running of the 24/7/365 real-time set up, and collaboration with a global team. This role directly powers a critical live customer-facing product safety product, which forms the foundation for multiple other safety features. You would be the expert at risk identification, for all our customers using our safety products. You would also work closely with the Research & Development teams, to power our in-house Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence models, by generating high quality training datasets. This requires an understanding of data requirements, data definitions, edge-cases, tooling and review processes. In addition to that, you would also work closely with the Product team to run proof of concepts and experiments, which guide the direction of our Safety product suite, particularly in the areas of risk identification, mitigation, and reduction. You would also contribute toward analyzing data to improve the user experience for our customers. You’ll work a regular five‑day schedule, including day, evening and/or overnight and weekend shifts as part of a rotation. Overnight (11pm - 7am for example) shifts include enhanced compensation where applicable.

What You'll Do


Review and analyze live videos captured by Motive's dashcam for risk identification, based on the known risk factors combined with the contextual knowledge which would vary from case to case.
Adhere to the established guidelines and protocols for annotation to ensure consistency and reliability of data.
Ensure timely delivery of accurate data as per SLAs.
Consistently strive to enhance the annotation procedures and play a role in shaping the team's best practices through active participation.
Exhibit flexibility and adaptability in taking on new responsibilities beyond the scope of the defined job description, showcasing a proactive and versatile approach to work.


What We're Looking For


Preferably, a Bachelors in Computer Science, IT, Management or related field.
Detail oriented and organized, with a growth mindset.
Thinks, designs and executes keeping customers at the center of the solution.
Interested in learning about the annotation landscape and application of AI/ML in the trucking industry.
Ability to work collaboratively, in a 24/7/365 set up, with strong context in between them.
The position requires working day, evening and overnight shifts and weekends, while maintaining a standard five-day work week overall.
Good communication skills, oral and written.

title: Product & Operations Sr. Analyst
skills: Define the strategy for your products or programs. Identify the passenger needs and business opportunities they should address, establish clear objectives, and develop a roadmap in partnership with relevant teams.

Own performance for your passenger cohort. Monitor retention, ride frequency, engagement, and program adoption. Analyze user behavior and market trends to understand changes, identify gaps, and recommend actions that strengthen competitive positioning.

Develop business cases and prioritize opportunities. Size the potential impact of new initiatives, estimate costs and expected returns, and articulate the assumptions and tradeoffs behind investment decisions.

Translate insights into product improvements. Combine quantitative analysis, passenger feedback, and research to identify opportunities across the passenger journey. Partner with Product and Design to turn those opportunities into clear requirements and experiences.

Lead cross-functional execution. Align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, Operations, CX, Marketplace, and BI on priorities, scope, timelines, and success metrics. Surface dependencies and risks early and keep initiatives moving from concept through launch.

Design and evaluate experiments. Develop hypotheses, partner on A/B tests or pilots, and assess whether initiatives generate incremental improvements in retention and frequency. Use the findings to recommend what to scale, refine, or stop.
Communicate results and recommendations. Turn complex analyses into clear narratives for stakeholders and leadership, explaining what happened, why it matters, and what should happen next.

2–4 years of relevant experience in product analytics, growth, business operations, strategy, loyalty, consulting, or a related role, with demonstrated ownership of initiatives and measurable outcomes.
Hands-on product experience. Experience partnering with product and technical teams to identify problems, define requirements, prioritize improvements, and evaluate results after launch.

Strong analytical capabilities. Proficiency in SQL and Excel or Google Sheets, with the ability to independently analyze data, build business cases, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Experience with additional programming languages, such as Python or R, and applying AI tools to automate workflows, accelerate analysis, or improve decision-making is highly valued but not required.
Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to clearly communicate insights to both technical and business stakeholders.

Understanding of customer behavior and performance measurement. Familiarity with cohort analysis, segmentation, retention, frequency, and customer lifetime value, including how these metrics inform product and investment decisions.

Experience with experimentation. Working knowledge of A/B testing, hypothesis development, and experiment interpretation, including the ability to distinguish observed changes from incremental impact.

Business judgment and structured problem-solving. Ability to break down ambiguous problems, assess tradeoffs, and prioritize opportunities based on passenger value, business impact, and execution effort.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to build alignment across teams, influence without formal authority, and present clear recommendations supported by evidence.
Ownership and execution discipline. Ability to manage competing priorities, follow through on details, and proactively address obstacles in a fast-paced environment.
Experience in a technology company, particularly a marketplace, mobility, delivery, e-commerce, or consumer subscription business.
Experience with loyalty programs, customer retention, lifecycle initiatives, subscriptions, or incentive design.
Familiarity with marketplace dynamics and how passenger incentives can affect demand, service availability, and profitability.
Experience with visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.
Experience evaluating unit economics and the financial sustainability of customer-facing programs.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

Through loyalty programs, targeted incentives, and product experiences, we strengthen retention, increase ride frequency, and deliver on the value we promise our passengers.

We are looking for a Passenger Loyalty Senior Analyst to own one or two key products or programs — including our Membership Program — serving a defined passenger cohort across Spanish-speaking Latin America (SSL). You will help shape their strategy, identify opportunities through data and passenger insights, build business cases, and work across teams to bring initiatives to life.

This role combines analytical depth, product thinking, and business ownership. You will be accountable for understanding what drives loyalty within your cohort and translating those insights into initiatives that deliver measurable improvements in retention and frequency while supporting sustainable business growth.

In this role, you'll be...


Define the strategy for your products or programs. Identify the passenger needs and business opportunities they should address, establish clear objectives, and develop a roadmap in partnership with relevant teams.

Communicate results and recommendations. Turn complex analyses into clear narratives for stakeholders and leadership, explaining what happened, why it matters, and what should happen next.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Hands-on product experience. Experience partnering with product and technical teams to identify problems, define requirements, prioritize improvements, and evaluate results after launch.
Strong analytical capabilities. Proficiency in SQL and Excel or Google Sheets, with the ability to independently analyze data, build business cases, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Experience with additional programming languages, such as Python or R, and applying AI tools to automate workflows, accelerate analysis, or improve decision-making is highly valued but not required.
Fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to clearly communicate insights to both technical and business stakeholders.
Understanding of customer behavior and performance measurement. Familiarity with cohort analysis, segmentation, retention, frequency, and customer lifetime value, including how these metrics inform product and investment decisions.
Experience with experimentation. Working knowledge of A/B testing, hypothesis development, and experiment interpretation, including the ability to distinguish observed changes from incremental impact.

Ownership and execution discipline. Ability to manage competing priorities, follow through on details, and proactively address obstacles in a fast-paced environment.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with loyalty programs, customer retention, lifecycle initiatives, subscriptions, or incentive design.
Familiarity with marketplace dynamics and how passenger incentives can affect demand, service availability, and profitability.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

About the job

About Us

Platzi is the largest technology school in the Hispanic world with over 5 million students and 4,000 companies trusting us to deliver effective online education. Our mission is to make Latin America a technology superpower. We do it by training companies and individuals in areas such as AI, Cybersecurity, English, Programming and Leadership.

As an industry leader, our presence is highlighted by our massive and fanatic community, extensive press coverage and a daily stream of success stories from students. We operate mostly remote, with key offices in Bogotá, Medellín and Mexico City.

Summary

As a Project Manager, you will lead the design and execution of high-impact educational projects with external partners such as companies, foundations, and governments. You will be responsible for aligning each initiative with Platzi’s strategic goals, creating customized learning programs that meet partner needs, and ensuring successful implementation while maintaining Platzi’s methodology and educational essence.

Requirements

What you'll do


Define the scope, deliverables, and objectives of each project, aligning expectations with internal and external stakeholders
Build detailed work plans, including timelines, milestones, and required resources for seamless execution
Lead implementation efforts across multidisciplinary teams, ensuring projects meet their intended goals on time and within budget
Continuously monitor key performance indicators , and produce progress and outcome reports
Maintain clear and consistent communication with client organizations—government entities, NGOs, corporate partners—and ensure high satisfaction
Identify opportunities to optimize and scale impact, adapting execution strategies as needed
Capture feedback and insights from partners to drive continuous improvement
Represent Platzi’s values and methodology while securing long-term partnerships and impact


Qualifications


3+ years of experience in Project Management, ideally in collaboration with external entities such as NGOs, companies, or government bodies
Proven track record managing complex projects with measurable impact, across multiple stakeholders
Strong command of project management methodologies (PMI, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent)
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Effective communication and negotiation capabilities, with experience in stakeholder engagement
Comfortable managing cross-functional teams and adapting to evolving project scopes
Experience working with KPIs, reporting tools, and data-driven project evaluation
Fluent in Spanish and English, capable of managing bilingual communications and documentation
Passionate about education, innovation, and social impact through learning


Benefits

💻 Hardware

With Platzi's help, you will have 100% of the necessary work tools such as a laptop, smartphone, desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, and other accessories.

📗 Books

We provide you with all the books you need to grow professionally on Kindle, and we give you the Kindle too 😉.

🐣 Maternity/Paternity Leave

At Platzi, we believe in gender equity and the importance of parents in the upbringing and care of their children. We make this a reality for new mothers and fathers through extended maternity and paternity leave.

💸 Option Pool

All members of the Platzi Team have the opportunity to own a part of Platzi and have company shares.

🌴 Vacation

You have 15 days of vacation per year regardless of the country you are in, starting from the moment you join the team.

💆‍♂️ Online Therapy

We care about your emotional health by covering the first four online therapy sessions with specialized companies.

🌐 Team Syncs

Although we are in different parts of the world, Platzi teams meet in person during the year to exchange ideas, build, and strengthen bonds.

Every year, the entire team gathers somewhere in the world for a week to meet face-to-face, get to know each other, have interesting discussions, and plan ambitious projects.

ABOUT US 




Storyteller is a high growth B2B SaaS platform, which allows companies to integrate Stories into their owned and operated platforms. Popularized by Instagram and Snapchat, Stories are perfectly suited for boosting user engagement, audience retention, and driving advertising revenue.

Conduct outbound follow-ups with newly onboarded or inactive partners to drive activation and engagement

Ensure fast, clear, and high-quality communication with partners
Proactively follow up with newly onboarded partners to drive activation and first revenue generation
Support the Partnerships team with operational and administrative tasks related to partner management
Create and manage support tickets, coordinating with Product, Tech, and Operations teams through Jira
Monitor partner onboarding and activation funnels, identifying friction points and improvement opportunities
Maintain accurate records and partner information within HubSpot and internal tools
Support basic reporting and tracking of partner performance and activation metrics
Identify upsell, cross-sell, or growth opportunities when relevant
Help ensure a positive and smooth partner experience throughout the onboarding journey


Requirements


2–3 years of experience in Operations, Partner Support, Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales Support, or similar roles
Professional fluency in Spanish and English (mandatory)
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Highly organized and detail-oriented
Strong proactive attitude and problem-solving mindset
Commercial mindset with strong willingness to help drive partner activation and growth
Comfortable working with CRM tools such as HubSpot and operational tools such as Jira
Basic analytical mindset with the ability to track partner activation and engagement
Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities in a fast-paced environment
Comfortable working cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders
Experience supporting customers, partners, or accounts in digital or online environments is a strong plus


Perks & Benefits


Full remote flexibility
International and entrepreneurial environment
Competitive salary package
Quarterly 30% variable compensation
Career growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling global company
Flexible working culture focused on ownership and impact
Learning and professional development support


During a trip to Thailand, Pedro and Lidia, the founders of Holafly, experienced the frustration of not having an internet connection.

Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do.

We love our work and we do it with pride. Stay connected wherever you go.

About the job

Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Partnerships Expert to build Clara's financing partnerships motion in Mexico. This is a role for someone who has already built a partner program inside a BNPL or embedded-finance company — recruiting merchants, platforms, and originators, writing the commercial offer, and making the channel produce volume. You will translate that craft to Clara: partnerships that put flexible financing, funded spend, and working-capital products in front of the companies that already trust another platform. You own the results of this motion end-to-end.

In this role, you will:


Build the financing channel: Map and recruit the partner types that can originate or distribute Clara financing: platforms, vertical software, lenders, and commercial networks where a company already makes a spend or credit decision.
Own the commercial design: Structure offers that work for both sides — origination economics, co-brand or co-sell, data and underwriting handoff, and a clean split that does not give away Clara's book.
Be strategically hands-on: Personally source, negotiate, and launch the first partners. This is not a vendor-management seat. You will be in the room until the motion is repeatable.
Connect product to distribution: Work with Product, Credit, Capital Markets, Legal, and Compliance so a partner can originate without breaking underwriting, KYB, or funding covenants.
Navigate internally: Be the single counterpart for partners and the translator for Sales and Success so financed volume is attributed, serviced, and expanded.
Operational excellence: Run onboarding, SLAs, portfolio health, QBRs, and a kill-or-scale cadence. Financing partners that do not produce quality volume exit the program.
Drive growth: Monitor originated volume, approval rates, ticket size, delinquency contribution, and partner-sourced revenue in HubSpot and Metabase. Pivot the mix when the book tells you to.
Workflow efficiency: Use Google Drive, Slack, and N8N to keep partner communication, document collection, and status flows tight as the portfolio grows.


Must have


Experience: Minimum 5 years in Partnerships, Business Development, or Channel inside BNPL, consumer/SMB lending, embedded finance, or a related credit product in Mexico.
Channel craft: You have built or scaled a partner/merchant/originator program — not only managed a handful of strategic logos. You know how to recruit, enable, and pay a network that produces volume.
Credit fluency: Enough command of underwriting, risk appetite, and unit economics to negotiate with partners without promising what Credit will not book.
Execution: Player-coach. Strategy plus direct negotiation and launch.
Performance driven: Proven volume, merchant, or originator growth through an indirect channel.
In-person collaboration: Based in Mexico City, hybrid, with regular office time and partner visits.
Tech-savvy: Experience or strong interest in AI tools to automate partner operations.


Nice to have


Analytical skills: Metabase, spreadsheets, SQL, or Python — especially cohort, approval, and loss views.
Relationships across Mexican fintech, acquirers, or commercial platforms.
Experience with corporate cards, expense management, or working-capital products.
Automation: N8N or Slack integrations.
A good sense of humor.


Why join Clara

At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are


We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. 
Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. 
Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. 
Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. 
Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. 
Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. 


What we believe in


#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. 
#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. 
#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. 
#Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. 
#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. 
#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. 


What we offer


Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one 
Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) 
Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths 
High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together 
Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact 
Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results 


If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.900 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research


Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight
Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards
Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences
Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans


Strategy & Execution


Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale
Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research
Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels
Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift 
Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams


Qualifications

Required


1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly


Nice to Have


Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About the job

Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Join Us

We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. We stand on change. Come stand with us.

Role Overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be the engine behind Paystand's B2B payments platform. This is an operator-focused role designed for a builder who thrives on shipping high-quality code and features. You will own the full product development lifecycle, ensuring that our core payment infrastructure is not only robust but consistently evolving to address the specific needs of the LATAM B2B payment market, including navigating regional financial complexities and local market requirements. You will bridge the gap between technical complexity and user value, unblocking engineering squads, managing tight release cycles, and directly driving the velocity of our product roadmap.

Key Responsibilities


End-to-End Execution: Own the product backlog, user stories, and requirements. You are responsible for taking features from initial concept to deployment, ensuring that what gets built matches the business requirement and technical specs.

Backlog Management: Maintain a high-quality, prioritized backlog. Proactively identify dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure the team is always focused on the most impactful work.
LATAM Product Leadership: Own the LATAM product roadmap, leading product discovery and delivery efforts tailored to the regional ecosystem, including core LATAM products such as Yaydoo and PorCobrar.


What We Are Looking For


5+ years of Product Management experience: Specifically in B2B SaaS, fintech, or complex platform environments.
Operator Mindset: You are a "Builder." You prefer working in the weeds with engineers to solve technical blockers over high-level conceptual planning.
Technical Fluency: You are comfortable working with APIs, data schemas, and cloud-native architectures. You don’t need to write the code, but you must be able to hold your own in technical debates with engineers.
Execution Track Record: A proven history of shipping complex features in high-velocity environments. You can point to products you’ve built and how you managed the development lifecycle to get them live.
Systems Thinking: The ability to decompose complex financial workflows (AR/AP, Reconciliation, ERP integration) into manageable, shippable components.

Why Paystand


Paystand is on a mission to reinvent commercial finance and bring B2B payments into the digital age.
You will join a team focused on product innovation, customer success, and disrupting outdated financial systems.
You will work with forward-thinking finance teams to build modern payment infrastructure.
You will help build the next version of Paystand: a high-ownership organization where your ability to execute has a direct, measurable impact on global B2B commerce.


Perks & Benefits

Fuel your days with free snacks and paid lunches in the office.
We've got your health covered with Major Medical Health Insurance.
Stay nourished with food vouchers and plan for your future with savings funds.

If you're passionate about driving change in the FinTech landscape and being part of a company that is shaping the future of digital payments, we invite you to explore opportunities with Paystand.

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience manifests in diverse ways, skills are transferable, and passion is a powerful driver. Your journey and skills are unique, and we value the richness that diverse perspectives bring to our team.

More than a resume, we prioritize a genuine commitment, impactful contributions, and the ability to thrive in our dynamic, collaborative environment. About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.900 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research


Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight

Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift

Required

Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

description:
About the job

SOMOS LIDERAZGO CON CONCIENCIA

En Natura, tenemos el potencial de impulsar transformaciones significativas. Esto es posible a través de los productos innovadores de Natura y Avon; las experiencias memorables de los servicios de belleza de Bluma y nuestra plataforma de educación financiera, Emana Pay. Marcas y servicios relevantes para quienes los utilizan y reconocidos por nuestro compromiso con la conducción de negocios regenerativos.

Ocupación

Permanente

¿Qué harás aquí?

Responsable de acompañar toda la experiencia de la Fuerza de Venta: Líderes, Gerentes de negocio y Gerentes de ventas de Natura, comprender mejor sus necesidades utilizando diferentes fuentes de investigación: encuestas, focus group, salidas a campo, etc. y utilizar estos datos para optimizar los procesos y actuar como un puente entre el equipo de ventas y todas las áreas de interfase.

¿Qué conocimientos y experiencias necesitarás traer para compartir con nuestra red?


 Análisis de Datos y Comportamiento de los públicos


Mapeo de la Jornada de los públicos de la Fuerza de ventas (Líder de negocio, gerente de negocio y gerente de ventas) identificando los puntos de contacto clave y las áreas de oportunidad para mejorar la experiencia del cliente.

Generar insights: Detectar insights de los datos obtenidos de diversas fuentes (CRM, encuestas, interacciones, visitas a campo, focus group, etc.) para entender el comportamiento, las necesidades y preferencias de los públicos en cada etapa de su Jornada.

Gestión de performance (KPIs).


Desarrollo de Estrategias y Herramientas de Venta:


Optimización de Procesos: Identificar y optimizar los procesos de venta para mejorar la eficiencia del equipo y la experiencia del cliente.

Desarrollo de Contenido: Colaborar en la creación de contenido relevante y personalizado para cada etapa de la jornada del cliente.

Selección de Herramientas: Evaluar y seleccionar herramientas de ventas (automatización de procesos) que faciliten la gestión de clientes y el seguimiento de la jornada.

Responsable de la etapa de crecimiento y retención de la jornada de la Fuerza de ventas (líder de negocios/Gerente de negocios y Gerente de Ventas).

Comunicación: Colaborar con la creación del plan de comunicación, contenido y materiales de nuevas herramientas de gestión, lanzamientos, comunicaciones de impacto a los públicos y sustentación.


 Soporte al equipo comercial


Brindar información al equipo de ventas sobre el uso de herramientas, nuevas estrategias y la importancia de la jornada del cliente. Sustentación del modelo

de negocio.

Crear informes y dashboards que permitan al equipo de ventas visualizar el progreso de los clientes en su jornada y tomar decisiones informadas. Gestión y evolución de las herramientas de performance.

Mantenerse actualizado sobre las últimas tendencias en ventas, marketing y comportamiento del consumidor.

Analizar los resultados de las estrategias implementadas y realizar ajustes para mejorar la eficacia del equipo de ventas y la experiencia del cliente.

Comportamiento de los pú

¿Qué encontrarás aquí?

Somos más que un lugar de trabajo: construimos y vivimos diariamente el Ecosistema Bien Estar Bien, basado en la relación armoniosa entre cada individuo, las relaciones a su alrededor y el entorno en el que está inmerso. Además de ofrecer beneficios enfocados en el bienestar social, físico, financiero, mental y emocional, promovemos un ambiente de prosperidad, pertenencia y propósito, fortaleciendo una red sólida de apoyo, expansión de la conciencia y respeto por la diversidad, equidad e inclusión.

Somos un movimiento que transforma la forma de vivir y hacer negocios en 14 países de América Latina, siempre guiados por la conciencia.

¿Conoces a alguien en Natura?

Si es así, solicita el correo corporativo de esa persona y, al postularte a una vacante, utilízalo para solicitar una recomendación. ¡Es una excelente oportunidad para fortalecer tu red de contactos y avanzar en tu proceso de selección con nosotros!

Natura celebra y abraza la diversidad en todas sus formas y pluralidades.

Invitamos a #Mujeres, #PersonasNegras, #PersonasConDiscapacidad, personas de la comunidad #LGBTQIA+, #MujeresEmbarazadas y personas con #50años+ a postularse para esta vacante.

Translate highly technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand terms for both customers and internal management.

We offer a collaborative environment where your technical expertise is valued, and your career growth is supported. Help us keep the world's supply chains, hospitals, and retail floors running smoothly.

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

title: Client Services & Intake Specialist Bilingüe
description:
About the job

🚀 Especialista en Atención al Cliente y Recepción de Casos (Inglés/Español)




📍 Tiempo completo | 100% Presencial




Horario: Lunes a viernes de 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM




🌟 ¡Únete a un bufete de abogados en crecimiento donde la empatía y la excelencia marcan la diferencia!




Buscamos un Especialista en Recepción de Casos Bilingüe para actuar como primer punto de contacto con clientes potenciales que se comunican tras sufrir un accidente o lesión. Este puesto es ideal para alguien que combine una empatía genuina con sólidas habilidades organizativas; alguien capaz de transmitir tranquilidad a una persona que atraviesa un momento difícil, recopilar con precisión los detalles de su caso y establecer el tono de toda la experiencia del cliente con el bufete.




📋 Responsabilidades Clave




-Actuar como primer punto de contacto para las consultas de nuevos clientes a través de teléfono, correo electrónico y formularios web o chat, respondiendo de manera rápida y profesional.

-Realizar entrevistas iniciales detalladas y empáticas para recopilar información sobre el accidente, las lesiones, los seguros y otros datos relevantes del caso.

-Registrar y organizar con precisión la información del cliente y del caso en el sistema de gestión de casos de la firma.

-Evaluar y calificar a los clientes potenciales según los criterios de la firma, derivando rápidamente los casos viables a los abogados y gestores de casos.

-Dar seguimiento a los clientes potenciales que aún no han formalizado su contratación para resolver dudas y orientarlos sobre los pasos a seguir.

-Coordinar con gestores de casos, asistentes legales y abogados para asegurar una transición fluida una vez que el cliente contrata los servicios de la firma.

-Realizar el seguimiento y reportar las métricas de admisión (volumen de llamadas, tasa de conversión, tiempos de respuesta) según sea necesario.




✅ Requisitos Indispensables

-1 a 2 años de experiencia en recepción de casos legales o apoyo legal (legal intake/paralegal support), o en entornos de atención al público o servicio al cliente en el ámbito médico o sanitario (por ejemplo, consultorios médicos o clínicas).

-Nivel de inglés avanzado B2+,C1

-Capacidad de manejar interacciones delicadas con clientes relacionadas con lesiones y reclamaciones por daños personales.

-Capacidad demostrada de empatía y escucha activa; facilidad para interactuar con personas que a menudo se encuentran bajo estrés, lesionadas o con dolor.

-Capacidad para gestionar llamadas entrantes actuando como primer punto de contacto de la firma.

-Capacidad para desenvolverse en un entorno dinámico y de alto volumen de llamadas, manteniendo siempre un tono tranquilo y tranquilizador.

Persona confiable y profesional, con disponibilidad para trabajar de forma presencial y a tiempo completo en el centro de operaciones (nearshore).




⭐ Requisitos Deseables

Experiencia previa en derecho de lesiones personales o en un entorno de recepción y gestión inicial de casos legales. Familiaridad con software de gestión de casos o CRM (p. ej., LeadDocket o Filevine). Experiencia en el manejo de conversaciones delicadas o emocionalmente difíciles (p. ej., en los sectores de salud, seguros o puestos relacionados con la gestión de crisis).




🎯 Perfil Ideal

Este puesto es ideal para alguien que lidera con empatía: una persona capaz de escuchar sinceramente a alguien describir uno de los peores días de su vida y hacerle sentir escuchada, al tiempo que recopila de manera eficiente la información que el equipo legal necesita. El candidato ideal es cercano pero organizado, tiene un trato agradable pero presta atención a los detalles, y se enorgullece de ser la voz serena y competente al otro lado de la línea.

¿Cuál será tu principal objetivo?

Serás responsable de dar seguimiento a los prospectos interesados en adquirir una franquicia Rentas.com, desde que dejan sus datos en nuestras campañas digitales hasta lograr que avancen en nuestro proceso comercial.

• Contactar oportunamente a los leads generados a través de campañas de Facebook, Instagram y otros medios digitales.

• Apoyar en el análisis y optimización de campañas digitales, principalmente en Meta Ads.

• Proponer nuevas campañas, contenidos, audiencias y estrategias de captación.


¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Buscamos principalmente una persona comercial y proactiva, con excelente comunicación y facilidad para relacionarse con diferentes tipos de personas.

Es importante contar con:

• Facilidad de palabra y excelente comunicación verbal y escrita.

• Gusto por las ventas, prospección y seguimiento comercial.

• Perseverancia y disciplina para dar seguimiento a múltiples prospectos.

• Orientación a objetivos y resultados.

• Buena organización y manejo de herramientas digitales.

• Capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

Será especialmente valorada la experiencia o conocimiento en:

• Meta Ads / Facebook Ads.

• Marketing digital y generación de leads.

• Manejo de redes sociales.

• CRM y automatización comercial.

• Campañas de adquisición y conversión.

• Ventas consultivas, telemarketing, desarrollo de negocios o atención a prospectos.


¿Qué ofrecemos?

💼 Sueldo base + atractivo esquema de comisiones por resultados.

📈 Amplias posibilidades de crecimiento profesional dentro de una empresa y una red de franquicias en expansión.

🎯 Participación directa en la estrategia comercial y de marketing para el crecimiento de la marca.

🚀 Un puesto en el que tus resultados tendrán un impacto directo y medible en la expansión nacional de Rentas.com.

🤝 Capacitación y acompañamiento para conocer nuestro modelo de negocio y proceso comercial.


Modalidad

Tiempo completo y presencial en nuestras oficinas corporativas en Toluca, Estado de México.

Si tienes perfil comercial, disfrutas conectar con personas y además te interesa el mundo del marketing digital, queremos conocerte.

Postúlate y forma parte del crecimiento de Rentas.com.

Join an official TikTok Partner driving $20M+ in monthly GMV, placing you at the forefront of the global social commerce revolution.

The ideal candidate

Possesses exceptional written English skills and professional communication habits, capable of managing hundreds of creator interactions via email and WhatsApp.
Demonstrates proficiency in Google Sheets, CRM tools like Salesforce, and project management software such as Monday.com or Lark to track complex workflows.


Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

description:
About the job

Wonolo (Work Now Locally) is disrupting the $140BN temporary staffing industry. Founded in 2014, Wonolo's mission is to help people find consistent work. Through our two-sided tech marketplace, we connect hundreds of businesses in need of front-line workers with 2 million underemployed workers in local markets across the United States, within minutes. Wonolo has raised over $200M in funding which will continue to help us empower the in-demand workforce by democratizing access to flexible work, opportunities to learn new skills, a living wage, and comprehensive portable benefits and perks.




We are looking for a Growth Marketing Associate to work with Wonolo’s Marketing team. You will be employed by a third-party legal entity authorized to do business in the location in which you reside and you will provide contractual services to Wonolo’s Marketing team. We're building the B2C acquisition and activation machine that brings workers to Wonolo, helps them succeed on their first job, and keeps them coming back. You'll be the technical builder behind that machine, working alongside the team that leads funnel and lifecycle strategy, translating defined priorities into automations, AI-powered flows, and campaigns that run at scale.




You operate autonomously, with market data as your primary input for deciding where to focus and what to activate. You'll partner closely with the Business Operations team when you need qualitative context on specific customers or market conditions that the data doesn't capture. You'll use that context to prioritize where to activate, what campaign response fits the moment, and how your work contributes to revenue attainment across markets.




The right person thinks like a marketer and builds with low-code and AI tools. You're execution-oriented, detail-driven, and motivated by seeing your work directly move supply-side metrics. Are you excited about working with a close-knit team at a mission-driven, US-based technology company? If this is who you are or you can and desperately want to be, please read on!




We welcome qualified candidates located anywhere in Latin America #LI-Remote.




Who you are:




Campaign Execution

Monitor market health data across active markets independently and activate the right campaign response: new customer launching, customer ramping, low fill rate, supply churn, geographic supply gaps, and similar demand factors
Own campaign prioritization and execution end-to-end: pulling the right audience, selecting the right channel and message, turning campaigns on, and tracking performance through to outcome
Partner with the Business Operations team to gather qualitative intel on specific customers or market conditions that analytical data doesn't capture, and use it to sharpen decisions you're already making
Work from established playbooks while flagging when market conditions call for something outside the standard response
Report campaign performance back to the team with a clear read on what worked and what to adjust




Campaign Automation & Activation

Use your campaign execution work as the foundation for everything you build, leveraging what you learn from running campaigns to inform what you turn into scalable systems.
Map the worker journey from acquisition through activation to understand where friction lives, then build automations and AI-powered flows that remove it
Translate funnel strategy into systems: triggered campaigns, onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and the logic that runs them
Build tooling to test and iterate on activation and retention campaigns across markets so the team can move fast without manual effort
Build high-leverage automations that enable fast campaign activation across organic and paid channels, including social, job boards, answer engine optimization, and search




AI-Native Workflows

Identify marketing workflows that are still manual and rebuild them to be AI-native, focusing on where AI can improve speed, personalization, or conversion outcomes
Build AI agent workflows that support acquisition, content, and competitive intelligence, covering prompts, data sources, structured outputs, and the human checkpoints that need to stay in the loop
Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent output quality and tie results back to marketing KPIs
Stay current on new AI tools and revisit existing workflows to incorporate improvements as the technology moves




Who you are:




2 to 3+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, technical marketing, or a role where you owned both strategy and build
You've shipped internal tools that teams fully adopted and used to inflect marketing KPIs
You understand user behavior in a B2C funnel: what good activation looks like, where drop-off happens, and how to design around it
Experience with marketing automation platforms (Iterable, Smartly, or similar); you know how to build and optimize triggered campaigns, not just run them
You can build autonomously using low-code and AI tools; you don't need an engineering ticket to ship
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation loops
Experience building with tools like Zapier, Clay, Framer, or Lovable




If you have read up to this point, we hope you are excited about this opportunity to work at Wonolo! Even if your experience does not check every bullet point, we still highly encourage you to apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description.




Nice to haves:




Experience in a marketplace or gig economy product with a two-sided user base
Background in worker acquisition, supply-side growth, or B2C lifecycle marketing
Familiarity with paid acquisition channels and how to automate decisioning across them




Benefits and perks:




The opportunity for growth in a mission-driven and well-funded start-up
Company laptop
Paid time off, Holiday pay, and Unpaid time off
Access to no-cost on-demand mental health support, including counselling, mindfulness and meditation, and well-being courses
Ability to work from anywhere in Colombia, El Salvador, Costa Rica, or Guatemala (no more commutes!)
Team outings, happy hours, company off-sites, and more!




Important Notice Regarding Fraudulent Recruiting




Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @wonolo.com email addresses.




Employment scammers may impersonate legitimate recruiters, employers, or recruitment firms, using email, text messages, messaging apps (including, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, etc.), or fake social media accounts to contact you. They may advertise roles that do not exist, claim to represent Wonolo, or use our name and branding without authorization.




Wonolo is aware that individuals posing as recruiters have communicated with job seekers about positions with Wonolo that do not exist. We have received reports that the content and method of communication has varied, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive personal information.




Wonolo will never ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information. All open positions are posted in country specific employment portals available at https://info.wonolo.com/careers/. All legitimate job postings on third-party employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application directly through the Wonolo careers page.




Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Wonolo’s recruiting process in general should email recruiting@wonolo.com.




About Wonolo:




Wonolo is a two-sided job marketplace that serves over 2 million front-line workers, providing them access to flexible and consistent job opportunities across the United States within minutes, at companies such as Peloton, Coca-Cola, Neiman Marcus, Papa John's, and thousands more.




We are a remote-first company with 200+ full-time employees, and quickly scaling our team within the United States, Canada, and Latin America. We are well-funded and backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital, and Leeds Illuminate, among others.




Learn more about us:

Wonolo raises $140M to continue supporting over 1 million laborers and front-line workers

Wonolo is one of Glassdoor's best tech companies to work for in 2021

Why G2 Venture Partners Invested in Wonolo

Yong Kim (CEO) on why he's passionate about empowering the in-demand workforce




Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Equity, and Belonging

Wonolo welcomes you as you and celebrates our collective diversity. We work to serve the underserved, and we are built on the strength of our entire community. We know that diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make for the best teams, and help to drive high performance. We strive to ensure that our team represents different cultures, perspectives, and backgrounds, as these empower our team to come together to make the best decisions and the biggest impact.




Wonolo is an equal-opportunity employer. We work to ensure all people feel supported, empowered, and connected at work. A big part of this effort is through our support for members and allies of Employee Resource Groups. Individuals seeking to work at or with Wonolo are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
